scope: AI/RAG embedding provider selection and transactional ingestion
checks: When Spring AI EmbeddingModel is available, document chunks are embedded in one provider batch call.
Provider vectors are persisted with the configured embedding model name and validated shared dimension.
The same provider is used to create query vectors before cosine ranking.
Provider exceptions abort ingestion; the document row and partial embedding rows roll back together.
When no EmbeddingModel bean exists, the existing bixi-local-hash-v1 deterministic fallback remains active.
No API key or provider response is persisted in the evidence.
limitation: This focused suite uses an in-process provider double; it proves the Spring AI contract and transaction boundary, but does not prove a live third-party DashScope network call or model quality.
